# UNVRS

> UNVRS is an AI automation studio in Raleigh, NC, run by founder Connor Bolin. We build AI receptionists, lead follow-up, review management, invoicing follow-up, chatbots, and virtual teammates for small businesses across the Triangle (Raleigh, Cary, Durham, Chapel Hill, Apex, Morrisville, Wake Forest, Garner, Holly Springs, Knightdale, and Fuquay-Varina).

Plans start at $199 a month for a Virtual Receptionist, $499 a month adds Lead Follow-Up Automation and Review & Reputation Management, and the complete system starts at $799 a month. Final pricing depends on call volume and business needs. Every plan can be live in under two weeks. Our systems handle scheduling, reminders, follow-up, and administrative communication only; clinical, diagnostic, technical, and licensed-work decisions always stay with the client's own team.

## Services

- [AI Virtual Receptionist](https://universeaiconsulting.com/services/ai-virtual-receptionist/): Answers every call in one or two rings, books appointments, and hands off to a real person when needed.
- [Lead Follow-Up Automation](https://universeaiconsulting.com/services/lead-follow-up-automation/): Texts and emails new leads within seconds and keeps following up until they book or opt out.
- [AI Virtual Teammate](https://universeaiconsulting.com/services/ai-virtual-teammate/): An AI that owns one recurring back-office role end to end.
- [AI Chatbot / Auto-Bot](https://universeaiconsulting.com/services/ai-chatbot-automation/): A website chatbot trained on the client's own business, forms, and documents.
- [Review & Reputation Management](https://universeaiconsulting.com/services/review-reputation-management/): Automatic review requests and low-rating alerts.
- [Invoicing & Payment Follow-Up](https://universeaiconsulting.com/services/invoicing-payment-automation/): Fixed, friendly reminder timelines from invoice sent to paid.
